citation: History of Michigan City, Indiana (1908), early-settlement and merchant-license discussion of William Teall.
locator: William Teall arrived in 1834; licensed May 13, 1834 to vend merchandise; listed among Michigan Township residents
note: Exact-name, target-year Great Lakes merchant candidate. The Chicago letter return predates the May license and no direct source bridges the postal addressee to the Michigan City merchant, so identity remains unasserted.
